entries.title: Updated API errors so applications can distinguish traffic that increases too quickly from temporary model overload.
entries.summary: API新增错误码，区分流量增长过快与临时模型过载。

entries.title: Mutual TLS (mTLS) and X.509 workload identity federation are now generally available for the OpenAI API.
entries.summary: OpenAI API正式支持mTLS及X.509工作负载身份联合。

entries.title: Announced the deprecation of `whisper-1`, `gpt-4o-transcribe`, `gpt-4o-mini-transcribe`, and `gpt-4o-transcribe-diarize`.
entries.summary: 多款转录模型宣布弃用，Assistants API同日关闭。

entries.title: API customers can now select regional processing for an individual request by using a prefixed domain with an API key from a project having Global geography.
entries.summary: 全球地域项目现可为单次API请求选择区域处理。

entries.title: GPT-5.6 Sol now costs $4 per million input tokens and $20 per million output tokens, representing 20% lower input pricing and 33% lower output pricing.
entries.summary: GPT-5.6 Sol输入与输出价格分别下调20%和33%。

entries.title: Released the Prompt Caching dashboard on the OpenAI API platform.
entries.summary: API平台推出提示缓存仪表板，可跟踪命中率和令牌构成。

entries.title: Transparent backgrounds are now available in preview for `gpt-image-2` and `gpt-image-2-2026-04-21` in the Images API and the Responses API image generation tool.
entries.summary: GPT Image 2在Images与Responses API中预览透明背景。

entries.title: Announced Ultrafast mode, a new API service tier for GPT-5.6 Sol that runs up to 14x faster than Standard processing.
entries.summary: GPT-5.6 Sol推出最高快14倍的Ultrafast限量预览。

entries.title: Daybreak now offers two access tiers for approved defenders: Daybreak Blue and Daybreak Red.
entries.summary: Daybreak为获批防御者推出Blue与Red两个访问层级。

entries.title: Updated the **chat-latest** snapshot, which points to the latest model available in ChatGPT for Plus and Pro users.
entries.summary: chat-latest快照更新，指向Plus和Pro用户可用的最新模型。

entries.title: Fast mode now supports long-context requests for GPT-5.6 Sol, GPT-5.6 Terra, and GPT-5.6 Luna.
entries.summary: GPT-5.6三款模型的Fast模式现支持超过272K令牌的长上下文。

entries.title: Customers can now filter and group data by API key in the Usage and Costs dashboards.
entries.summary: 用量与成本仪表板及相关API新增按API密钥筛选和分组。
